sentences.text: Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he is going to the garden centre on Tuesdays and Thursdays to do plants and watering, where he receives payment.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he gets paid in the bank every two weeks on a Friday.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated the electricity went off for two days last month because he did not have money for the electric key.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he told Tom he forgot to top up the electricity, rather than telling him about the lack of funds.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated Dean said he would hurt him if he did not give him the money.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he felt scared when Dean asked for the money.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated Dean said he would hurt him if he did not give him the money last Friday.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated they never actually hurt him, only said they would.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he did not have enough money left after Dean and Lewis took the £100.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he does not want the police to come to his flat.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he knows the on-call number is on his fridge.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated Tom helps him with shopping on Mondays.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated Tom is 'sound'.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he sees his girlfriend Kayleigh and friends Dean and Lewis from the park.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated Dean and Lewis walk him to the cash machine on payday.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he takes out £100 from his bank account and gives it to Dean and Lewis every payday.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated Kayleigh does not take his money and sometimes buys him chips.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated Tom could come with him to the bank on Friday morning, which would mean Dean would not come.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he would like help with a budget, specifically a list, possibly with pictures.
Jamie Coulter (S2) stated he would still go to the garden centre even if support hours change.
